title: Small robot actuator catalogue for APE0 (50 cm, ~4.6 kg humanoid; 20 body joints + XM335 neck)
status: Desk research from maker pages, datasheets, retailers and community databases. Nothing here is measured on an APE0 part. Metrics are evidence to compare, not pass/fail thresholds.

classes.12V: 3S pack rail, 11.1 V nominal, 12.6 V full; figures reported at 12 V
classes.24V: separate 6S-class rail; figures reported at 24 V

method.units: kg.cm x 0.0980665 = N m; s/60deg -> rad/s = (pi/3)/t; rpm x 2pi/60 = rad/s
method.voltage_scaling: If a figure was published only at another voltage, the verbatim figure is kept in 'raw', the value is scaled linearly to the class voltage and 'scaled_from_v' is set. Current-limited peak torques of integrated BLDC actuators are not scaled.
method.prices: USD, quantity 1. Each price record has a 'basis': page loaded today, search-result snippet (page not loadable), or repo ledger 2026-10-08. comparison.price_usd_qty1 takes the lowest figure of the best available basis; it is not a quote and stock varies.
method.evidence_grades: manufacturer datasheet > manufacturer page > retailer > community database (servodatabase.com, maker-page mirrors, BAM identifications); the grade names the best source for the torque-speed figures
method.source_keys: every field carries 'src', a key into that entry's 'sources' map; 'repo:' URLs are read-only files in this repository
